summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 2.13/4)

data.turoyo: Gxurṭile, u gawo ste gxurṭi u zawlawo diḏe, kmanḏ̣əfile, w hedi bəṯr w kmašəġile w gəmbašlile, məlalle.
data.translation: Sie schaben ihn ab ..., auch vom Magen schaben sie den darin befindlichen Dreck ab und reinigen ihn. Dann, nachdem sie ihn gewaschen und gekocht haben, füllen sie ihn.

rationale: New I Infectum box; one short quotation contains both the surface-patient Gxurṭile and removed-material-patient gxurṭi.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC NE Famine/22)

data.turoyo: Ánnaqqa aw+watre du+săwā̀l, am+maʕye, ḥăramani, da+Kfarzoye zawnə́nwanne, xurṭíwaynanne xurṭíwaynanne xurṭíwaynanne xurṭíwaynanne, hul dəzzənwa bu+xurmo du+mḥaṭo, di+msalle.
data.translation: Now then, catgut, intestines, these godawful things, those that the Kfarzeans would buy, we would scrape, scrape, scrape, scrape them, until they would pass through the eye of a needle, of a packing needle.

rationale: New I Infectum-wa box; preserve all four emphatic repetitions in one context and the result limit.

summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (113/146)

data.turoyo: Komər ṣafrayto gxərṭo aš šarʕe, gkənšəlle w lə gmašiġo lo iḏa w lo poṯa hul deri yawmo, kəmmo: "Ma lo ṣafro ste gxərṭono?"
data.translation: Am Morgen kratzt sie den Dreck ab, fegt ihn zusammen und wäscht sich dann weder Gesicht noch bände bis zum nächsten Tage. Sie denkt: Muß ich nicht Morgen doch wieder kratzen?

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; a single context supplies third-person gxərṭo and first-person feminine gxərṭono with habitual and prospective readings.

summary: JTM 2.13/4 alternates an indexed scraped surface/organ (Gxurṭile) and an overt removed-material patient (gxurṭi u zawlawo diḏe), with stomach as topic in the second clause. The German vom Magen does not supply a source preposition in the Turoyo.
60/252 has flesh as patient and explicit me ʕal bones as source, contrasting with the unpreposed organ topic in JTM.

Infectum and Infectum-wa are absent from the supplied entry and are now represented. The habitual production account repeats xurṭíwaynanne four times for intensity; all repetitions stay in a single example.
The input supplies six occurrence records, including only one indexed record for the fourfold repetition; decisions match those six records exactly, without inventing additional records.
The inherited xaroṭo occupational word remains in Part act.; it does not establish a new finite sense of turning wood.
In JTM 2.13/4, which exact organ is the object of initial Gxurṭile? The next clause supplies stomach, but no preceding context is provided.
The same scraping meaning applies to flesh, stomach surfaces, intestinal tissue and dung; no separate cleaning or catgut-production sense is required.
